meta.title: 看了就会相当简单的pose教程

scenes.context: 每次拍照都像站军姿？两个知识点——交叉和支点，记住就能立刻实操。
sentences: 每次拍照跟站军姿一样。
Every photo makes me look like I'm at attention.
记住两个知识点：交叉和支点。
Remember two keywords: cross and pivot.
paraphrase: Every photo makes me look like I'm at attention.
Remember two keywords: cross and pivot.
scenes.speak: Every photo makes me look like I'm at attention. Remember two keywords: cross and pivot.

scenes.context: 人站好时四肢和身体平行；摆姿势时把一个平行的人变成交叉的，让四肢和身体保持交叉。
sentences: 正常站好四肢和身体平行。
Standing normally, your limbs parallel your body.
把平行的人变成交叉的。
Turn a straight person into a crossed one.
让四肢和身体保持交叉。
Keep your limbs crossing your body.
paraphrase: Standing normally, your limbs parallel your body.
Turn a straight person into a crossed one.
Keep your limbs crossing your body.
scenes.speak: Standing normally, your limbs parallel your body. Turn a straight person into a crossed one. Keep your limbs crossing your body.

scenes.context: 站姿：腿交叉、手也可以交叉；坐姿一样，插兜也是一种交叉。
sentences: Cross your legs, or cross your arms.
Hands in pockets count as a cross too.
As long as your body opens up.
paraphrase: Cross your legs, or cross your arms.
Hands in pockets count as a cross too.
As long as your body opens up.
scenes.speak: Cross your legs, or cross your arms. Hands in pockets count as a cross too. As long as your body opens up.

scenes.context: 坐在板凳或马路牙子上也是交叉：让四肢和脑袋躯干做互动，动作就会自然。
sentences: Sitting on a curb still counts as crossing.
Let your limbs play off your torso.
paraphrase: Sitting on a curb still counts as crossing.
Let your limbs play off your torso.
scenes.speak: Sitting on a curb still counts as crossing. Let your limbs play off your torso.

scenes.context: 你会发现很多动作都有三角形：插腰是三角形，搭头是三角形，一交叉还是三角形。把躯干想成方块，拿三角形往身上拼。
sentences: Many of your poses form a triangle.
插腰是三角形，搭头也是。
Hand on hip is a triangle; hand on head too.
把躯干想成方块往上拼。
Think of the torso as a box and build triangles on it.
paraphrase: Many of your poses form a triangle.
Hand on hip is a triangle; hand on head too.
Think of the torso as a box and build triangles on it.
scenes.speak: Many of your poses form a triangle. Hand on hip is a triangle; hand on head too. Think of the torso as a box and build triangles on it.

scenes.context: 支点就是你身边的环境：有桌子可以倚靠，有凳子可以靠，有墙、门、窗户也可以倚靠，主要和环境做互动。
sentences: 支点就是你身边的环境。
A pivot is whatever surrounds you.
Rest one hand on a table.
paraphrase: A pivot is whatever surrounds you.
Rest one hand on a table.
scenes.speak: A pivot is whatever surrounds you. Rest one hand on a table. Walls, doors, windows—all fair game.

scenes.context: 交叉是身体的互动，倚靠是环境的互动。拍照时记住这两个词，身体行动就能跟上。
sentences: Crossing is interacting with your body.
Leaning is interacting with the space.
脑子里有关键词，身体就能跟上。
Keep the keywords in mind and your body follows.
paraphrase: Crossing is interacting with your body.
Leaning is interacting with the space.
Keep the keywords in mind and your body follows.
scenes.speak: Crossing is interacting with your body. Leaning is interacting with the space. Keep the keywords in mind and your body follows.

scenes.context: 下次拍照照这个方法，多练几次就好，这套方法简单又耐用。
sentences: A few more tries and you'll get it.
This trick is simple and reusable.
paraphrase: A few more tries and you'll get it.
This trick is simple and reusable.
scenes.speak: A few more tries and you'll get it. This trick is simple and reusable.
